ZeroData.Sql Code Generator - Generate entity classes and SqlContext from DBML or SQL database

Usage:
  zerodata-sql-codegen <input.dbml> [options]          (from DBML file)
  zerodata-sql-codegen -c <connection-string> [options] (from SQL Server)

Options:
  -o, --output <path>       Output file path (single-file) or directory (split)
  -n, --namespace <ns>      Target namespace (default: Models)
  -c, --connection <cs>     Database connection string
  -p, --provider <name>     DB provider: sqlserver (default), mysql, postgresql, sqlite
      --context <name>      Override context class name
      --split               Generate one file per entity (recommended for large DBs)
      --single-file         Generate all entities in one file (default)
  -h, --help                Show this help

Examples:
  zerodata-sql-codegen dbRAF.dbml
  zerodata-sql-codegen dbRAF.dbml -o Models/dbRAF.cs -n RAF.Models
  zerodata-sql-codegen dbRAF.dbml --split -o Models/ -n RAF.Models
  zerodata-sql-codegen -c "Server=.;Database=RAFInventory;Trusted_Connection=true" -n RAF.Models
  zerodata-sql-codegen -c "Server=localhost;Database=app;Uid=root;Pwd=..." -p mysql -n App.Models
  zerodata-sql-codegen -c "Host=localhost;Database=app;Username=postgres;Password=..." -p postgresql
  zerodata-sql-codegen -c "Data Source=app.db" -p sqlite -n App.Models
